name: Days since last incident
description: A safety streak board for a factory floor, warehouse or site: a huge count of days (or hours) since the last incident, the best-ever record, a green/amber/red target gauge, required-PPE signs and rotating safety messages. On the day of an incident it turns red and says so. A supervisor can reset it from a Google Sheet.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: last_incident
params.label: Date of the last incident
params.help: YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM for an exact time (in the timezone below). A connected data source overrides it.

params.name: incidents
params.label: Incident data source (optional)
params.help: A Google Sheet or Manual table with a column holding the last incident date. The most recent date in that column wins.

params.name: best_col
params.label: Best-record column (optional)
params.help: A column holding the best-ever streak in days. Ignored when the source has no such column.

params.name: unit_label
params.label: Unit word
params.help: Leave empty for the word in the chosen language (days, Tage, jours...).

params.name: since_label
params.label: Label before the incident date
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in text in the screen's language.

params.name: incident_today_label
params.label: Shown on the day of an incident
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in text in the screen's language.

params.name: incident_today_note
params.label: Line under it on that day
params.default: Make the area safe, report it, look after each other.

params.name: best_label
params.label: Heading: best record
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in text in the screen's language.

params.name: new_record_label
params.label: Shown when the record is beaten
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in text in the screen's language.

params.name: target_label
params.label: Heading: target
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in text in the screen's language.

params.name: amber_days
params.label: Amber from (days)
params.help: Below this the board is red.

params.name: status_green
params.label: Status text: green
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in text in the screen's language.

params.name: status_amber
params.label: Status text: amber
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in text in the screen's language.

params.name: status_red
params.label: Status text: red
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in text in the screen's language.

params.name: messages
params.label: Safety messages
params.help: One per line. They rotate along the bottom. Leave empty to hide the bar.
params.default:
Report every near miss. It is how we stay at zero.
Forklift zone: pedestrians keep to the marked walkways.
Three points of contact on every ladder and step.
Spotted a spill? Stop, block it off, report it.
Lift with your legs, and ask for help with anything over 25 kg.
Tired or unwell? Tell your shift lead. No questions asked.

params.name: ppe_heading
params.label: Heading: PPE signs
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in text in the screen's language.

params.name: ppe_labels
params.label: PPE names
params.help: Six names separated by |, in this order: hard hat, eye protection, hi-vis, gloves, boots, ear protection. Empty names use the built-in ones in the screen's language.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Site timezone
params.help: Days roll over at midnight here. Leave empty to use the screen's own clock.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language
params.help: The words, dates and numbers on screen, for example en-GB or de-DE. Leave empty for the screen's language.
